125 million customers means about 6.4 million complaints a year

Access received 3.06 million complaints in 2025, about 8,400 a day, and closed the year with 6,575 open. Voice still carries 80% of customer interactions.

Sources: Annual Report 2025, p.106 (3,055,829 received; 6,575 pending). Avaya Access Bank case study (over 60 million customers; 125 million target by 2027; 80% of interactions on voice). Illustrative: 3,055,829 × 125 ÷ 60 = 6.37 million. Complaints are only part of all contacts, so the full workload is larger.

Even at half of fibertime's result, Access avoids about half the extra hiring

If agents grow with complaints, the team roughly doubles. At half of fibertime's gain it grows 56%. At fibertime's full result it grows about 4%.

Illustrative, not a forecast. Complaints rise 2.08x (3.06m to 6.37m). fibertime: volume 5x, headcount 2.5x, so agents per contact fell 50%: 2.08 × 0.5 = 1.04. Half that gain (25%): 2.08 × 0.75 = 1.56. fibertime is a fibre provider, so bank results may differ. Source: CXG Integrated Experiences Case Studies, 2026.

Behind the chat

  1. AI finds the transaction in seconds
  2. The case is logged and the customer kept informed
  3. A helpful offer is made at the right moment
  4. An agent joins whenever the AI cannot resolve it
  5. Next day, CSAT and root cause reach the Resolve or Refer team
